D: A young lion prince flees his kingdom after his father's death and must return to claim it.
P: Serve the grub mousse when Timon and Pumbaa teach Simba about grubs.
S: Kidney beans simmered in coconut milk with tomato and turmeric, with warm chapati

Red kidney beans in a Swahili coconut sauce, and no worries for the rest of your days. Soften a diced onion in 2 tbsp oil with 2 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp ginger and a chopped chilli. Stir in 1 tsp turmeric and 1 tsp cumin, add 2 diced tomatoes and cook 5 minutes. Add 2 drained 400g tins red kidney beans and 400ml coconut milk and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Warm 4 chapati in a dry pan and serve with coriander.
Lime and chilli beef skewers, charred on the grill

Swahili street skewers, and no lunch lost to Zazu. Mix the juice of 2 limes, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp cumin and 2 tbsp oil. Toss 800g diced rump through it and marinate 2 hours. Thread onto 8 skewers and grill over high heat 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until charred. Serve with lime wedges.
Mango, papaya, pineapple and passionfruit with lime, chilli salt and mint
Wedges of mango, papaya, pineapple and passionfruit on ice, with lime, a pinch of chilli salt and fresh mint.
M: grilled chilli chicken with kachumbari salad

Kenyan grilled chicken, the way the lionesses would want it. Blitz 4 garlic cloves, 2 red chillies, the juice of a lemon, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp paprika and 60ml oil. Rub over a butterflied 1.8kg chicken and marinate 2 hours. Roast at 220C for 45 minutes until the skin crackles. For the kachumbari, toss 3 diced tomatoes, a finely sliced red onion, coriander, lime juice and salt. Serve together.
Swahili spiced rice cooked with beef, cumin, cardamom, cinnamon and cloves

Spiced beef and rice in one pot, the way it's cooked down the Swahili coast. Brown 600g diced rump in 2 tbsp oil, add 2 sliced onions and cook until golden. Stir in 3 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp ginger, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp ground cardamom, a cinnamon stick and 4 cloves. Add 400g basmati rice and stir to coat, then 750ml beef stock. Cover and simmer on low 18 minutes, rest 10 minutes, fluff with a fork and serve with lime.
W: Chocolate mousse, cookie dirt, gummy worms and mint. Slimy yet satisfying.
Gummy worms buried in cups of dark chocolate mousse with crushed chocolate biscuit dirt, a mint leaf on top.
Cardamom coconut doughnut triangles, fried and dusted with icing sugar

Coconut and cardamom dough rested an hour, cut into triangles, fried at 170C until puffed and golden, dusted with icing sugar. Mix 400g flour, 7g yeast, 80g sugar, 1 tsp cardamom and 250ml warm coconut milk to a soft dough and rest an hour. Roll out, cut into triangles and fry at 170C until puffed and golden. Dust with icing sugar.
K: Mango, pineapple and passionfruit punch topped with lemonade and lime
Mango, passionfruit and pineapple juice with lemonade and lime, poured over crushed ice.
